subject: Insurance
title: Funeral Microinsurance
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Funeral Microinsurance.

hook.text: In South Africa, funeral insurance is the most purchased financial product. Funerals cost 5-10 times a monthly salary.

discovery.text: Funeral microinsurance costs $2-5 per month and pays a lump sum within 48 hours of death.

twist.text: Fraud is common. Some policies have been claimed using fake death certificates.

climax.text: Funeral insurance shows how cultural norms create insurance markets.

punchline.text: $2 a month, payout within 48 hours. Cultural duty drives insurance demand.

quiz.question: Why is funeral insurance so popular in South Africa?
options: Cultural expectations make funerals extremely expensive relative to income
